Name: Monster Men Livestock V2.0
Author: ArcanaCapra
Description:
This is an updated/fixed version of CommanderWaddles' mod, "Monster Men Livestock". I have permission from the original author to post this.

[b][i]A BFAV version of the mod (made by Kidiroxas) can be found[/i][/b] [b][i]here: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6136]Monster Men Livestock for BFAV.
[/url][/i][/b][url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6136 ]
[/url]

The mod that replaces vanilla livestock with sexy monster men, but updated! Each beast is a mythical or legendary creature with connections to Stardew Valley. 

Besides bugfixes (such as the missing trash can), I've also made a version that should be fully compatible with [b]sion9000[/b]'s [b]Anthro Characters Continued - (Furry Overhaul Mod)[/b].

[size=4][b]Content:[/b][/size][list]
[*]White Cow → Incubus
[*]Brown Cow → Minotaur
[*]Goat → Anubis
[*]Sheep → Fluffy Centaur
[*]Pig → Basilisk 
[/list][list]
[*]Animal Shop Menu icons are replaced
[*]Animal descriptions now correspond to the following monster
[*][s]Purchased animals will start off as babies and evolve into Monster Men once they have reached adulthood. For example, a baby brown cow will evolve into a Minotaur once it hits maturity. No monster babies for you. Big sad. [/s]There are no babies, so just-purchased Monster Men will look like adults, but won't produce anything. I highly recommend using [i][b]Ui Info Suite [/b][/i]by [i][b]cdaragorn.[/b][/i]
[s][/s][/list][size=4]
[b]Installation:
[/b][/size]1)   Make sure you have "SMAPI" and "Content Patcher" installed.
2)   Download this mod “[CP] Monster Men Livestock” and unzip into your Mods folder.
3)   Enjoy your new sexy beasts! 

Peroxidewren's "Adventure Time Hairstyles" and Monmsky's "Monster Girl Livestock" mods were used as the base for the Fluffy Centaur sprite. Melnoelle's "UnderDark Sewer" was used as the background for the Incubus lore.

[center]* ﻿* ﻿* ﻿* ﻿*[size=6][/size][/center][size=6]
[/size][center][size=6][u]LORE[/u][/size][size=5][code]
[/code]Entry#398: Mythical Legends of Stardew Valley[/size][b][size=5][/size][/b][/center][b][size=5]

Anubis[/size][/b]
[size=4]A legendary monster that appeared from the abysmal depths of Skull Cavern. Rumors say that he was worshipped as the guardian of Calico Desert.
Sandy recalls from a popular bedtime story that Anubis is the patron of lost souls, guiding wandering mummies back into eternal slumber. He loves goat milk and will sometimes offer some to the farmer.
[/size]
[size=5][b]
Basilisk[/b][/size]
[size=4]A crowned reptile reputed to be the legendary king of serpents, ruling over all snakes in Calico Desert. His lethal gaze contains the ability to turn enemies who wish to harm the farm into stone, somehow leaving behind truffles within their crumbled remains???
The farmer also does not understand where the truffles come from, but questions nothing under the Basilisk’s threatening glare. [b]

[/b][/size][size=5][b]
Fluffy Centaur[/b][/size]
[size=4]A mythical creature from a hidden tribe within the Secret Woods. Usually has the upper body of a man and the lower body of a horse… but this Centaur has a rare condition known as the ‘Fluffles’. Wool will sporadically grow all over his body, causing him to be laughed at by his peers.
He agrees to stay at the farm, as long as the farmer promises to regularly shave off his wool. Under all the fluff reveals an attractive toned man.[/size]
[size=5][b]

Incubus[/b][/size]
[size=4]A legendary sex demon that was summoned to the valley by the Witch. He has flirtatious charm and endless stamina. The Incubus is amused by the farmer’s reactions to him and feels something more than lust. He is constantly aroused and will attempt to seduce the farmer, shamelessly producing high quality ‘milk’ right before the farmer’s eyes. The people of Pelican Town fall in love with the dairy product and keep asking for more, but the farmer refuses to meet their eyes.
[/size][size=5][b]

Minotaur[/b][/size]
[size=4]A mythical creature rippling with strength, said to be part-man and part-bull. The Adventurer's Guild found him wandering the lowest levels of the Mines. The Minotaur has a dominant showboat personality and loves to flex. He will eagerly produce ‘milk’ everyday if the farmer agrees to feel his powerful muscles.[/size]
